title: Verification
lead: Connect your accounts through the official login. We read your stats; we never post for you.
submittedToast: Sent for review. We usually answer within a day.
pendingBody: Usually within a day. You will get an email and a notification.
approvedBody: Brands see your Verified badge. Keep your accounts connected so the stats stay fresh.
connectLead: At least one is needed to apply.
instagramNote: Instagram works with Business or Creator accounts. You can switch for free in the Instagram settings.
publicNote: Accounts must be public, one per platform. We check every account before brands see it.

review.pendingHint: We are checking this account. It will count for briefs once approved.
review.rejectedManual: Not approved: {reason} Fix it and save again, or remove the account.
review.rejectedConnected: Not approved: {reason} Fix it and connect it again, or remove the account.

manual.hint: Or you can add the account manually. We check it during review.
manual.title: Add an account manually
manual.lead: The account must be public. Only the username and followers are required; the more you fill in, the better we match you with briefs. Brands see that you added these numbers yourself.
manual.profileUrlHint: Leave empty and we build it from the username.

submitReady: We will check your profile and accounts.
submitNeedsAccount: Connect at least one account first.
removeBody: Brands will no longer see it. You can connect it again any time.
noDemographics: This platform does not share audience demographics.
